465-728-3175.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-3967-6094.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4050-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

1308-3129-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-3129-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

851-4365-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Altered Ego each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5434-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Yarus can be omitted.

2440-5663-7895--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Little Bear token.
When the Little Bear token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Little Bear token.
Repeat.
2440-5663-7895--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Little Bear.

3532-3536-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-5078-7656.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top"
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3992-6596.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Hermes
1618-2440-3992-6596.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-6596.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Hermes. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

443-2292-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3259-4460-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-4460-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2511-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

11-121-799-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-799-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Karn's Temporal Sundering spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Karn's Temporal Sundering from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

104-3490-4050-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-6823.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3558-4050-4053-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that has power or toughness 1 or less and that can be cast using one colored mana.
3558-4050-4053-6989.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-2034-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2585-4241.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using Karn.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

1473-3197-3487.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3234-3293-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
997-3234-3293-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat
997-3234-3293-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-6878.description:
Activate Qala by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Qala triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5396-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat from step 2.

4681-4894-6542-6797.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1477-2558-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1477-2558-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

813-3378-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Illusionist's Stratagem.
813-3378-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

856-2279-2511-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2279-2511-4321.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2781-5686-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2781-5686-6132.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

333-2292-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2292-5617.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1309-2104-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
1309-2104-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
1309-2104-5626.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2577-4210-5670.notablePrerequisites:
Pious Evangel can be on the battlefield transformed.
Your life total is at least 2.
2577-4210-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

186-4131-4694.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-4131-4694.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

803-1789-2232-3558.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2529-3593.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand.
Vedalken Mastermind do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}{R}.
1636-2529-3593.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping it, adding at least {U}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting any creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning a creature card from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1303-1769-5147.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

776-1329-2709-3092.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-3092.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Orochi Hatchery to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Orochi Hatchery.
Cast Orochi Hatchery.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
